seo_desc: Highland Christmas events for kids in 2026: a library winter luau with Santa, letters to Santa and costumes, plus nearby Redlands and San Bernardino fun.
lede: Highland keeps its Christmas close to home with a library luau where kids can meet Santa and write him a letter, and plenty more within a short drive.
celebrates: Highland celebrates the season with community programs built around families. The Highland Branch Library on Central Avenue, part of the San Bernardino County Library, turns its December winter luau into a holiday afternoon where children meet Santa in person, write him a letter, play games, make crafts and wear costumes. Families who check out library books can earn an incentive along the way. Highland sits next to Redlands and San Bernardino, so many local families pair the library event with a lighted parade, a farm Christmas train or a downtown Santa event just a few minutes away.
lastyear: The county library runs its winter luau across many branches each December, and Highland's branch is one of them, with the same mix of games, crafts and prizes for families. Highland's police and fire departments also run an Operation Santa Claus toy drive each holiday season, according to the Highland Chamber of Commerce calendar. We could not confirm the 2026 dates for the Santa fire truck route on a host page, so we are not listing it, and families should check the city's website for the latest schedule.
facts: Highland is a city in San Bernardino County at the foot of the San Bernardino Mountains, between San Bernardino and Redlands. The Highland Branch Library is at 7863 Central Avenue, and it is open until 8 pm on Wednesdays, which makes the 4 to 6 pm luau easy to reach after school. The city's own offices are at 27215 Base Line, according to its website, and families who want more Christmas events usually look to Redlands, San Bernardino and Rancho Cucamonga, each with its own guide on our site.
trains: Highland does not list a holiday train of its own, but nearby Redlands has the Live Oak Canyon Christmas Train, which rides through a Garden of Lights to Santa's Village on weekends. For vintage railway fun, the Southern California Railway Museum in Perris runs trains in the Inland Empire, and the museum has a page on our site. Check each host's website for dates and ticket prices, since train tickets can sell out before the weekend.
